meta.title: 2招，接发快球不再怕！
meta.title_en: 2 Moves to Never Fear a Fast Serve

scenes.title_cn: 开场：面对高速平击，别拉大架势
scenes.title_en: Opening: Keep It Small Against a Fast Serve
scenes.context: 教练开场点出接发球两大技巧：前顶与挥长。平击一发高速砸来，反应时间很短，不要拉开架势，而是小引拍、身体前顶去建立。
sentences: 你知道接发球需要前顶、挥长这两大技巧吗？
Do you know the two key moves for returning a fast serve? Step in, and follow through.
return a serve（接发球）
像这种平击的一发都是高速砸过来的，留给你的反应时间很短。
A flat serve like this comes at you at full speed, leaving you almost no reaction time.
flat serve（平击发球）
我们不要拉开架势，而是通过一个小引拍前顶身体去建立。
Don't load up a big backswing — keep the take-back small and step into the ball.
take-back（引拍）
paraphrase: It comes at you way too fast to think.
scenes.speak: Do you know the two key moves for returning a fast serve? Step in, and follow through. A flat serve like this comes at you at full speed, leaving you almost no reaction time. Don't load up a big backswing — keep the take-back small and step into the ball.

scenes.title_cn: 要领：像墙一样前顶，随挥要长
scenes.title_en: The Two Keys: Step In Like a Wall, Follow Through Long
scenes.context: 把人想象成一面墙或盾牌，向前迎击把球撞过去。第二要领是随挥要长，这关系到回球稳健；像长枪管狙击枪一样，轨迹越长越稳越准。
sentences: 把人想象成一面墙或者是一个盾牌，向前迎击把球撞过去。
Picture yourself as a wall or a shield, driving forward and sending the ball right back.
drive forward（向前迎击）
第二个要领是随挥要长，这关系到回球稳健。
The second key is a long follow-through — it's what makes the return solid.
follow-through（随挥）
枪管更长的狙击枪，比小手枪弹道更稳、射得更准。
A sniper with a longer barrel shoots straighter than a pistol — same idea here.
barrel（枪管）
paraphrase: Step through the shot like you mean it.
The longer your swing path, the more reliable the ball.
scenes.speak: Picture yourself as a wall or a shield, driving forward and sending the ball right back. The second key is a long follow-through — it's what makes the return solid. A sniper with a longer barrel shoots straighter than a pistol — same idea here.

scenes.title_cn: 避坑与收束：压住重心，充分挥长
scenes.title_en: Pitfall & Wrap-Up: Stay Low, Swing Through
scenes.context: 反面示范：过早过短收拍、重心过早向上，回球质量低、容易失误。正确做法是压住重心、充分挥长，像扫倒一排障碍物一样完整送拍。
sentences: 过早过短的收拍，往往还伴随着重心过早的向上，回球质量低、容易失误。
If you cut the swing short too early and lift your weight too soon, your return gets weak and error-prone.
cut the swing short（过早收拍）
所以要压住重心，充分的挥长。
So stay low, and give the swing full length.
stay low（压住重心）
就好像要扫倒桌上这一排连续的障碍物。
It's like sweeping a row of bottles off a table in one clean motion.
sweep（横扫）
paraphrase: You bail out of the swing too soon.
Finish the stroke all the way through.
scenes.speak: If you cut the swing short too early and lift your weight too soon, your return gets weak and error-prone. So stay low, and give the swing full length. It's like sweeping a row of bottles off a table in one clean motion.

practice.a: Don't load up a big backswing for a fast serve.

practice.q: 「像墙一样向前迎球」怎么表达？
practice.a: Step into the ball like a wall.

practice.q: 「随挥越长越稳」用英文怎么说？
practice.a: A longer follow-through makes the return steadier.
Stay low and finish the stroke all the way through.

pitfalls: Swing harder to handle a fast serve.
Keep the take-back small and step into the ball.
Big swings need time you simply don't have against a fast serve.
Cut the follow-through short to recover faster.
Follow through fully, well past your body.
A short finish kills the ball's stability and drives up errors.
Rise up early to gain power.
Lifting your weight early destroys control on the return.
Think of the return as just swinging at the ball.
Think of it as sweeping through a row of obstacles.
The sweep image keeps the swing long, smooth, and continuous.
shifts: 快球来了就加大挥拍、用力硬接
小引拍前顶，动作越小越来得及
